what: Manual check of the CLIP diagnostic itself, on the two random 48-photo sheets produced by audit_part1.py (seed 0)

clip_says_dog.doubtful_items: #3 blurry window, #11 landscape (tiny dog?), #19 blurry fur close-up, #26 dog painting

clip_says_not_dog.notes: mostly cats, sheep, cows, a lion, a giraffe, plush toys, a statue; the dogs it misses are small in a scene or next to people/cats (scores 0.33-0.89, below the strict 0.90 threshold)

extra_finding: the Kaggle dataset contains non-dogs (sheep, cows, lion, giraffe, plush toys) labelled with dog emotions; Part 1's YOLO correctly removed those
previous_audit: 40 random photos of data/rejected/cats (2026-11-26): ~25 dogs, ~12 cats, a few with both
